DPolyFaceToMat
create inMesh inm generic
inMesh accepts mesh
inMesh storable 0
inMesh writable 1
inMesh readable 0
add inMesh
create FaceNumber fnum int 0
FaceNumber min 0
FaceNumber keyable 1
add FaceNumber
create outMatrix omat generic
outMatrix accepts matrix
outMatrix writable 0
outMatrix storable 0
add outMatrix
create outTranslate ot generic
outTranslate accepts numeric 3double
outTranslate accepts numeric 3float
outTranslate writable 0
outTranslate storable 0
add outTranslate
create outRotate or generic
outRotate accepts numeric 3double
outRotate accepts numeric 3float
outRotate writable 0
outRotate storable 0
add outRotate
affects inMesh outMatrix
affects FaceNumber outMatrix
affects inMesh outTranslate
affects FaceNumber outTranslate
affects inMesh outRotate
affects FaceNumber outRotate
